name: Weights & Biases Weave Service API
description: Weave is W&B's LLM observability and evaluation platform. The Weave Service API provides REST endpoints for managing calls (traces), objects, tables, feedback, scores, evaluations, annotation queues, and files. The core W&B experiment tracking uses GraphQL (not covered here).
